content: On eight biomedical NER tasks, we cover over 50% of the BioBERT – BERT F1 delta, at 5% of BioBERT's domain adaptation CO$_2$ footprint and 2% of its cloud compute cost. We have also shown how to rapidly adapt an existing BERT QA model to an emerging domain – the Covid-19 pandemic – without the need for target-domain Language Model pretraining or finetuning.
